http/internal/http2_preface#

The connection preface (RFC 9113 §3.4): the client's magic and SETTINGS, the server's SETTINGS, and the first ACK.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The connection preface (RFC 9113 §3.4): the client's magic and SETTINGS, the server's SETTINGS, and the first ACK.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object Http2ClientPreface#

object Http2ClientPreface

The client's side of the preface.

Http2ClientPreface.Http2ClientPreface#

Http2ClientPreface(input is AsyncReading, output is AsyncWriting, settings is Http2Settings)

Speaks on input and output, advertising settings.

Http2ClientPreface.settings#

async settings() is Http2PeerSettings

Sends the preface, reads the server's SETTINGS, acknowledges them and gives them.

object Http2ServerPreface#

object Http2ServerPreface

Prior-knowledge or ALPN-selected server side. Never guesses the protocol; the caller owns the transport and its opening deadline. Sending SETTINGS first prevents either endpoint from waiting for the other's advertisement.

Http2ServerPreface.Http2ServerPreface#

Http2ServerPreface(input is AsyncReading, output is AsyncWriting, settings is Http2Settings)

Speaks on input and output, advertising settings.

Http2ServerPreface.settings#

async settings() is Http2PeerSettings

Sends our SETTINGS, reads the client's magic and SETTINGS, acknowledges them and gives them.
